supplies.title: Supply requests

summary.title: Purchase summary
summary.description: Identical items from the selected requests are added up by name and unit.

supplies.rejectedHint: The request is closed. The cleaner sees the refusal and its reason in the app.

catalog.title: Supply catalogue
catalog.description: The cleaner picks request lines from this list and types only the quantity. The name is in the company language; translations are optional.
catalog.empty: The catalogue is empty: cleaners type names by hand for now
catalog.name: Name

filters.search: Search by title, listing or person

actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this task? It stays as history.

form.name: Title
form.generatedHint: This task came from a booking or a problem: its listing and kind cannot be changed.

work.title: How the cleaning went
work.correctionHint: The measurement stays as it is — the correction lives beside it and is what the report counts.

form.descriptionNew: A password is made automatically and posted straight away. You will see it on screen.
form.descriptionEdit: The address cannot be changed here: it is set once.
form.name: Name
form.emailHint: This is the address they will sign in with.
form.emailLocked: The address is the login, and it changes only through support.
form.languageHint: Letters go out in this language. In the app they pick their own.

password.title: Password for {{name}}
password.description: This is the only time the password is readable: from here on it is stored hashed and cannot be shown again.
password.mailSent: The login and the password have been posted to {{email}}.

links.title: Listings: {{name}}
links.description: "Assigned" hands the job over the moment it appears. "From the queue" leaves it for whoever takes it first.
